name: Fort Kochi & Mattancherry
summary: Colonial streets, Chinese fishing nets, cafés, art galleries and centuries of spice-trade history.
todo: Watch the Chinese fishing nets at sunset
Visit St Francis Church and the Dutch Palace
Walk through Jew Town to the Paradesi Synagogue
Kochi-Muziris Biennale venues in Biennale years

name: Kumbalangi Village
summary: A model tourism village near Kochi with canoe rides, crab farming and village life.
todo: Village lunch with a local family

name: Cherai Beach
summary: A long, quiet beach with backwaters on one side and the sea on the other.

name: Thattekkad Bird Sanctuary
summary: Kerala's first bird sanctuary, in lowland forest on the way to Munnar.
todo: Early-morning birding walk with a guide
Look for Malabar grey hornbills and frogmouths

name: Alappuzha (Alleppey)
summary: The houseboat capital: palm-lined canals, paddy fields below sea level and village life on the water.
todo: Shikara or canoe ride through narrow canals
Nehru Trophy Boat Race in August–September

name: Marari Beach
summary: A calm fishing-village beach, good for slowing down after a houseboat trip.
todo: Morning walk with the fishing boats

name: Kumarakom
summary: Lakeside backwaters on Vembanad Lake, a bird sanctuary and Kerala's model Responsible Tourism village.
todo: Houseboat or sunset cruise on Vembanad Lake

name: Munnar
summary: Rolling tea estates, misty peaks and cool nights at about 1,600 m (5,200 ft).
todo: Waterfalls on the drive up (Cheeyappara, Valara)

name: Eravikulam National Park
summary: Grasslands home to the endangered Nilgiri tahr. Usually closed for a few weeks in Feb–Mar for the calving season.

name: Thekkady & Periyar Tiger Reserve
summary: Spice gardens and one of India's best-known tiger reserves, with boat trips and guided treks.
todo: Boat ride on Periyar Lake (book officially)
Guided nature walk or bamboo rafting
Kalaripayattu or Kathakali show in town

name: Vagamon
summary: Rolling meadows, pine forest and paragliding, quieter than Munnar.

name: Ramakkalmedu
summary: A windy hilltop viewpoint over the Tamil Nadu plains, between Munnar and Thekkady.

name: Varkala
summary: Red cliffs above the sea, a relaxed café strip, yoga classes and the sacred Papanasam beach.
todo: Walk the North Cliff at sunset
Swim only where lifeguards are on duty
Janardhana Swamy Temple (outside only for non-Hindus)

name: Kovalam
summary: Three crescent beaches (Lighthouse, Hawa, Samudra) and many Ayurveda resorts.

name: Poovar
summary: A golden sandbar where the river meets the sea, reached by boat.
todo: Boat ride through the estuary and mangroves

name: Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum)
summary: The capital: Padmanabhaswamy Temple, museums, Napier Museum and the Kuthiramalika Palace.
todo: Padmanabhaswamy Temple (Hindus only, strict dress code)

name: Ponmudi
summary: A hill station with 22 hairpin bends, an easy day trip from Trivandrum.

name: Munroe Island & Ashtamudi Lake
summary: Narrow village canals best explored by canoe at sunrise.

name: Jatayu Earth's Center
summary: A giant bird sculpture on a rock hilltop, reached by cable car.

name: Sabarimala
summary: A major hilltop pilgrimage. The Mandala–Makaravilakku season (mid-Nov to mid-Jan) draws huge crowds; entry and dress rules apply.
todo: Read the official rules before planning a visit
Expect very heavy traffic in the season

name: Gavi
summary: Remote forest eco-tourism inside the Periyar landscape; visits are limited and must be booked.
todo: Book through the official eco-tourism programme

name: Thrissur
summary: Kerala's cultural capital, home of the Thrissur Pooram festival (Apr–May).

name: Kerala Kalamandalam
summary: The famous school for Kathakali, Mohiniyattam and Koodiyattam. Morning classes can sometimes be watched.
todo: Join the 'A Day with the Masters' programme (book ahead)

name: Athirappilly & Vazhachal Falls
summary: Kerala's largest waterfall, at its most powerful during and just after the monsoon.
todo: Expect closures after very heavy rain

name: Guruvayur
summary: One of Kerala's most important temples (Hindus only) and the Punnathur Kotta elephant yard.
todo: Respect dress rules in the temple town

name: Silent Valley National Park
summary: Ancient rainforest with lion-tailed macaques. Visits only by official forest department jeep from Mukkali.

name: Nelliyampathy
summary: Orange and tea estates on a winding road with views over the Palakkad plains.

name: Parambikulam Tiger Reserve
summary: A well-run tiger reserve with forest stays, treks and bamboo rafting, reached via Tamil Nadu.

name: Kozhikode (Calicut)
summary: Malabar food capital, spice markets, sunset beach and the old port town of Beypore.
todo: Eat Kozhikodan biryani and halwa on SM Street
Kappad Beach, linked with Vasco da Gama's 1498 arrival

name: Wayanad
summary: Coffee and spice plantations, forest wildlife, caves and treks on a high plateau.

name: Kannur & Theyyam
summary: The heartland of Theyyam ritual performances, quiet beaches and Portuguese-era St Angelo Fort.
todo: Attend a Theyyam (check the official Theyyam calendar)

name: Muzhappilangad Drive-in Beach
summary: A long, firm-sand beach where you can drive along the shoreline.
todo: Drive along the beach (follow local rules)

name: Bekal Fort & Beach
summary: A huge 17th-century fort on a headland above the sea, with quiet beach resorts nearby.

name: Valiyaparamba Backwaters
summary: Quiet northern backwaters with small islands and far fewer boats than Alappuzha.

name: Kottakkal
summary: Home of the Arya Vaidya Sala, one of India's best-known Ayurveda institutions.
